short_description: Builds a dividend income portfolio of 15–20 stocks with safety scores, growth streaks, payout checks, monthly income and 10-year DRIP projections, sector balance and tax notes, ranked from safest to most aggressive.
skill_description: Builds a dividend income portfolio blueprint: 15-20 dividend stocks with tickers and current yield, dividend safety score (1-10), consecutive years of dividend growth, payout ratio analysis flagging unsustainable dividends, monthly income projection for the user's investment amount, sector diversification, 5-year dividend growth estimates, 10-year DRIP compounding projection, tax implications by account type, and a ranked list from safest to most aggressive, with an income projection table. Use when the user wants passive income, dividend stocks, an income portfolio, yield, DRIP or a monthly income target.
starters: Build a dividend portfolio from my investor profile
